rounds.kill_strategy: This mutant is unkillable under any input values. The mutation affects a dead variable (ROW_TILES) that is computed but never read or used. No value-level test can distinguish the mutant because the computed value never influences any execution path or output. This is a classic case of dead code mutation that can only be detected through static analysis, not dynamic testing.
rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing frameworks should incorporate dead code detection to filter out mutations to unused variables before dynamic testing. A simple static analysis pass checking whether a defined variable is ever referenced would have identified ROW_TILES as dead code, avoiding 250+ futile test rounds. For kernel developers: remove unused variables like ROW_TILES that were perhaps left from refactoring, as they waste register space and create misleading code.
